name: Corrosive Blood (Monster)
body:
Prerequisite(s): Aberration, at least one spell-like or supernatural ability

Benefit(s): When you are hit with a piercing or slashing weapon, all creatures within 5 feet must make a successful Reflex save (DC 10 + 1/2 your Hit Dice + your Constitution modifer) or suffer 1d6 points of acid damge. For every three Hit Dice you possess, the acid, unless neutralized, lasts for another round (to a maximum of 6 additional rounds at 18 Hit Dice), dealing another 1d6 points of damage in each round.
